# Branches the stale-branch cleanup never archives, and never deletes once
# archived. Read by .github/scripts/archive_stale_branches.py.
#
# One entry per line: an exact branch name, or "re:" plus a regex searched
# anywhere in the name -- anchor it with ^ and $ to mean the whole name, as the
# entries below do. # and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Protected branches and the head or base branch of an open pull request are
# exempt without being listed. A line added here after a branch was archived
# still spares the archive copy, though restoring the branch stays manual:
#     git push origin archive/<date>/<name>:<name>
# That puts it back at the same commit, as old as it was, so add the line here
# (or push a commit) or it is archived again.
#
# Every line is something that breaks if the branch moves. Say which, so the
# next reader can tell a live entry from a stale one.

# Default branch, and the name it goes by in older clones and forks.
main
master

# The published documentation site. Deleting it takes the docs offline.
gh-pages

# Long-lived integration branch; several teams cut from it.
stable

# Release branches. 16 of these were already past 30 days on 2026-09-15, and
# being untouched for a year is what a shipped release looks like.
re:^release/.*$
re:^v[0-9].*$
